grader.method: Two independent, blind grader runs, one per review. Each grader received the scenario input, the semantic assertions, and a single unlabeled review, in a fresh --safe-mode context with no tools, CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks, MCP, memories, or agents. Neither grader was told which review it graded.
